title: crataegus succulenta var. macracantha
intro: Crataegus succulenta var. macracantha, commonly known as Chinese hawthorn, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, known for its unique succulent features and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chinese hawthorn include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing blood pressure, and alleviating digestive issues due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its traditional use in Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Chinese hawthorn include oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
